svg.title: Galveston Bay, the lower Mississippi, Los Angeles-Long Beach, and New York tower over the rest of the coast

cc:Work.dc:title: Galveston Bay, the lower Mississippi, Los Angeles-Long Beach, and New York tower over the rest of the coast
cc:Work.dc:description: Spike map of the lower 48 states with a vertical spike on each hexagon, sized by distinct large ships; the tallest spikes stand at Galveston Bay, the lower Mississippi, Los Angeles-Long Beach, and New York.
